Lucia Fernandez  
Email: lucia.fernandez@adventuremedia.com | LinkedIn: linkedin.com/in/luciafernandez | GitHub: github.com/luciafernandez  
📍 Berlin, Germany  

Professional Experience  
As a Senior Data Engineer at AdVantage Media, I lead the architecture and scaling of real-time data pipelines that underpin the company’s ad targeting platform. My work focuses on ensuring sub-second latency for campaign performance metrics, which directly impacts revenue growth. Over the past three years, I’ve architected a Kafka-based streaming infrastructure that processes 150 million events daily, reducing data latency by 40% compared to previous batch workflows. This system now serves as the backbone for dynamic ad personalization, contributing to a 25% increase in click-through rates for high-priority campaigns.  

Prior to this, I spent 12 months as a Data Engineering Intern at BrightSpot Analytics, where I designed ETL pipelines for user engagement metrics on Snowflake. My work involved transforming raw clickstream data into actionable insights for 10+ client accounts, improving data availability from 72 hours to under 2 hours. I also optimized Snowflake query performance by 35% through schema reorganization and materialized views, enabling faster reporting for business intelligence teams.  

My journey began as a Data Analyst Intern at ClickAd Network, where I analyzed ad campaign performance using SQL and Python. I developed automated dashboards that reduced manual reporting time by 50%, allowing the team to shift focus to strategic analysis. This role solidified my ability to bridge data engineering and analytics, a skill I continue to refine at AdVantage.  

Education  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science, University of California, Berkeley (2018)  
Graduated with honors, specializing in distributed systems and database optimization. My thesis explored the trade-offs between real-time analytics and batch processing, a topic that remains central to my work in adtech.  

Technical Skills / Technologies  
Apache Kafka: Designed and scaled a multi-region streaming architecture that handles 150M+ events daily, ensuring fault-tolerant data ingestion for ad targeting. Mentored two junior engineers on best practices for partitioning and consumer group management.  
Apache Spark: Optimized batch processing pipelines for user behavior analysis, reducing job runtime by 45% through dynamic resource allocation and query refactoring.  
Data Warehousing: Spearheaded the migration of ad campaign metrics to Snowflake, achieving 99.95% query reliability and 30% cost savings via partitioned storage strategies.  
ETL Pipeline Design: Built a reusable framework for data transformation that is now used across three product teams, cutting deployment time for new data sources by 60%.  
Apache Airflow: Orchestrate complex workflows for ad campaign reporting, ensuring dependencies between data pipelines are resolved with 99.8% uptime. This system processes over 200M records monthly.  
Python: Regularly leverage Pandas and NumPy for exploratory data analysis, and use PySpark for large-scale data transformations.  
Java: Occasionally used for integrating legacy systems with Kafka, focusing on message serialization and deserialization.  

Projects / Side Projects  
Developed a real-time anomaly detection system for ad traffic using Kafka and Spark Streaming, reducing false positives by 20% through custom rule engines.  
Contributed to an open-source project optimizing PostgreSQL performance for adtech workloads, resulting in a 25% improvement in query throughput.  

Languages  
English (native), Spanish (fluent), German (basic)  

Awards & Achievements  
Recognized as AdVantage Media’s “Innovation Champion” for redesigning the ad targeting pipeline, which reduced latency by 40% and contributed to a 15% revenue uplift in Q4 2023.  
Selected to present at the 2023 Data Engineering Summit on best practices for Kafka streaming in adtech, with the session viewed by over 5,000 professionals.
